text: Docs: matching ignores letter case. Implementation lowercases both operands before equality comparison.
Docs: timeout defaults to five seconds. Code: timeout = options.timeout ?? 5000; unit is milliseconds.
Docs: deletion is a dry run by default. Code: dryRun = options.dryRun ?? false; false executes deletion.
Docs: empty names are rejected. Code: validation accepts every string including the empty string.
Docs: cache is shared across processes. Code excerpt only imports a Cache class without its implementation.
Docs: writes are atomic. Code shown only declares the save(record) function signature.
Docs: list results are oldest first. Code: ORDER BY created_at DESC, where larger timestamps are newer.
Docs: omitted retries means no retry. Code: retries = options.retries ?? 0; count zero performs only the initial request.
